root-cause: AppKit dims a status item on the unfocused display by drawing its NSStatusItemReplicantView snapshot at alpha 0.5, but only when ((button.image != nil) && !button.image.isTemplate) at snapshot time (gate in -[NSStatusItem _redrawReplicantSnapshot:sourceView:], AppKit 0x18cba57c4-0x18cba5930). We never set button.image, so the gate treats the empty cell as already-styled and skips the dim; our SwiftUI PassthroughHostingView snapshot renders at alpha 1.0. [measured via AppKit disassembly; prior art: exelban/stats 11b3449/9f2135f fixed the identical symptom with button.image = NSImage()]. Evidence note: docs/research/2026-10-21-status-item-inactive-dim.md
